== Course of events ==

Having been disarmed and taken prisoner by the Army of Revolt, the companions are brought before General Jinjur, who now holds power in the palace. It is in this moment of confrontation that Jinjur threatens to destroy each companion in a gruesome way, directing her hostility at the captured group. Alongside this threat, she gives the order that Tip is to be returned to old Mombi, reasserting a claim over the boy that predates her seizure of the throne.

The threat brings together General Jinjur, Old Mombi, and Tip as the central figures of the moment: Jinjur as the one issuing the gruesome threat and the command, Old Mombi as the figure to whom Tip is to be sent back, and Tip as the one targeted by that order. The pairing of a violent threat against the companions with the specific instruction concerning Tip marks Jinjur's assertion of authority over both the prisoners and the boy in a single stroke.
